notes.title: Gameplay Experience Enhancement Update
notes.notes:
[h1]【Update Contents】[/h1]
[h2]🎮 In-Game Controls UI Added[/h2]
Added an in-game UI that displays control instructions. This makes it easier for new players to get started with the game.

[h2]🎯 Fundamental Fix for Ball Escape Issues[/h2]
We have implemented a fundamental solution to the issue where balls would escape outside the stage boundaries. We have focused particularly on areas where stage boundaries meet, where this problem occurred most frequently, and significantly improved the system to prevent balls from escaping outside the stage.

These improvements provide a more stable and comfortable gameplay experience.

notes.title: Fixed Incorrect Ball Respawn Bug
notes.notes:
In a previous update, we added a feature to respawn the ball at the center when it falls out of the stage.
However, it was mistakenly respawning even when it shouldn’t have.
This update fixes that issue—now the ball only respawns under proper conditions.

notes.title: Update Notes: Bomb Speed Boost, Ball Respawn Fix & More
notes.notes:
[h2]Ball Respawn When Exiting Stage[/h2]
As a safeguard against the ball leaving the stage, we've added a system where the ball will now automatically respawn near the center if it goes out of bounds.
This ensures uninterrupted gameplay and a smoother overall experience.

[h2]Bomb Speed Adjustment[/h2]
The bomb's movement speed has been increased by 50%.
This makes it easier to hit targets and improves overall usability of the item.

[h2]Item Box Size Increased[/h2]
The size of item boxes has been increased by 1.4x.
This makes items easier to collect and improves the game's pace.

[h2]Minor Player Behavior Adjustments[/h2]
We’ve fixed subtle bugs and inconsistencies related to player angle handling.
This update aims to make controls feel more natural and comfortable.

notes.title: Mouse Sensitivity Settings
notes.notes:
We've added a new mouse sensitivity adjustment feature to the game! You can now customize your mouse sensitivity through the in-game settings menu.

Key Features:
- Adjustable mouse sensitivity slider in the settings panel
- Range from 1.0 to 5.0 with increments of 0.5
- Default sensitivity set to 3.0
- Changes apply instantly for easy testing

This update improves the gaming experience by allowing you to find your perfect sensitivity setting for better control and precision.
